comparison.objective: Level and seat an add-on board over two rows of header pins without bending them; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-pin alignment and even insertion pressure versus recessed tool engagement, screw torque, fine rotation, and iterative testing.
comparison.success_condition: Board fully seated, level, unbent, still, and released; candidate requires safe repeated carriage stops and stable setting.
comparison.reason: Connector insertion is explicitly absent from the candidate and tests different contact mechanics.
